messages.subject: Half single, half multiple indicator RI-CLPM
parts:
Hi there, I am attempting to write syntax for a RI-CLPM which has two variables - one in which we are treating as an observed variable, and one as a latent variable (multiple indicator).

I have been trying to merge the two example codes of a basic single indicator and a multiple indicator by Mulder and Hamaker  - but continue to get warning messages indicating I'm not specifying this correctly.

I'd be interested if anyone has ever attempted this - or if its even possible.

Thanks!
